add.issue.comment.md:
Solution:
Added plain-language package failure classification and a redacted, opt-in GitHub report flow. Required failures offer one report before aborting; optional failures explain each package and offer one combined report at the end. The bundle includes the log tail and bounded system/package context, strips personal and network identifiers, and never prompts off-TTY, during dry runs, or when reporting is disabled. Uncommitted worktree changes pass 116 pytest tests, the affected shell regression tests, ShellCheck, bash syntax checks, and git diff checks.
